segments.an5.67:1.1: “Yo hi koci, bhikkhave, bhikkhu vā bhikkhunī vā pañca dhamme [ime pañca dhamme (ka.)] bhāveti, pañca dhamme [ime pañca dhamme (ka.)] bahulīkaroti, tassa dvinnaṃ phalānaṃ aññataraṃ phalaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ –
segments.an5.67:1.2: diṭṭheva dhamme aññā, sati vā upādisese anāgāmitā.
segments.an5.67:2.2: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu chandasamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgataṃ iddhipādaṃ bhāveti,
segments.an5.67:2.7: Yo hi koci, bhikkhave, bhikkhu vā bhikkhunī vā ime pañca dhamme bhāveti, ime pañca dhamme bahulīkaroti, tassa dvinnaṃ phalānaṃ aññataraṃ phalaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ –
segments.an5.67:2.8: diṭṭheva dhamme aññā, sati vā upādisese anāgāmitā”ti.

lines: Aṭṭhame attano bodhimaṇḍe paṭividdhe āgamanaiddhipāde kathetvā upari attanova cha abhiññā kathesīti.
66-70. Chaṭṭhe saha ājīvanti etthāti sājīvo, pañhassa pucchanaṃ vissajjanañca.
